summary:
w134 reviewed: one commit, 8f54c17 (branch gone; taken between ready->claimed 9cc45b1 and claimed->done d9571b5).
No features/ change, no test removed or weakened, no allowances claimed. Ruff, vulture and size are clean.
r66/r81/r82 are implemented as planned under the answer of 2026-10-24 (Reading A).
Fix now (Important): supervise_all.take catches only Refused, so a thread that crashes (GitFailed etc.) can still end in exit 0.
Observation (Important): keep_round, the delegated answers' section+commit, workqueue.add in drafting and merge --abort run outside the shared lock. Across initiatives they race on index.lock, and r28's put-back can revert another initiative's uncommitted write.
Minor: the analysis session takes no shared slot (r60); supervise_review.py was edited outside the file set (disclosed); result.json's commits field has no hash; a no-op filter in supervise_all.py:43.
questions: Important, scripts/supervise_all.py:27-31,46-48: take() catches only Refused; a non-Refused exception in an initiative's thread is only printed by threading.excepthook and run_all can exit 0 (r82) although that initiative's nodes can still move; with one initiative the same crash exits non-zero.
